# Blygger Studio 0.35.1

*Released 2026-10-07, the reference client. [v0.35.1 on GitHub](https://github.com/blygger/blygger-studio/releases/tag/v0.35.1).*

**Migrations: none.**

- **An absolute `page` is used as it is.** §16.6e lets a blyg's permalinks
  live outside its mount (Soapbox's are WordPress post URLs), but every link
  built from `page` glued it onto the origin, giving
  `https://site/blyg/https://site/archives/…`. That covered reading-view
  source links, quote attribution, stub citations, and the target of every
  mention sent to such a blyg, so a mention to Soapbox would have failed on
  arrival. Found subscribing the official blyg to robertpeake.com.

Protocol: implements 0.3 (eleventh revision), plus the reader half of the
§16.6e 0.4 shape.



*This announcement is drafted from the release's section of [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/blygger/blygger-studio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md), which is where it is maintained. To comment, respond to this item from your own blyg.*

Blygger Studio 0.35.1

Released 2026-10-07, the reference client. v0.35.1 on GitHub.

Migrations: none.

  • An absolute page is used as it is. §16.6e lets a blyg's permalinks live outside its mount (Soapbox's are WordPress post URLs), but every link built from page glued it onto the origin, giving https://site/blyg/https://site/archives/…. That covered reading-view source links, quote attribution, stub citations, and the target of every mention sent to such a blyg, so a mention to Soapbox would have failed on arrival. Found subscribing the official blyg to robertpeake.com.

Protocol: implements 0.3 (eleventh revision), plus the reader half of the §16.6e 0.4 shape.

This announcement is drafted from the release's section of CHANGELOG.md, which is where it is maintained. To comment, respond to this item from your own blyg.
